captions.linkedin:
Asness, Moskowitz and Pedersen tested value and momentum in 8 asset classes. Both factors showed up in every single one.

That is the rarest result in quant finance. One signal, 8 markets, decades of data, all positive.

Here's the complete logic from the 2013 Journal of Finance paper. No black box:

🔹 NEGATIVE CORR. Value and momentum average -0.49 correlation globally, so blending one with the other cuts drawdowns.
🔹 EIGHT MARKETS. Stocks, bonds, currencies, commodities and index futures, all in one framework.
🔹 MONTHLY REBALANCE. Rank-weight each security by signal inside its asset class.
🔹 SIGNAL LAG. Momentum uses 12-month minus 1-month. Value uses a 5-year reversal proxy.
🔹 INVERSE VOL WEIGHT. Scale each class to equal risk so commodities don't dominate the book.

Paper sample ends July 2011. Post-publication compression is documented. Net-of-cost returns are lower than gross. You verify the numbers yourself.
